_comment: Bot-identity roles assignable via `/role <name>` in a bot's direct chat. Each role patches the bot's own registry row (workspace, skills, model) and restarts it. Patch keys are bounded by ROLE_PATCH_KEYS in scripts/lib/bot-roles.mjs — a role that touches anything else is refused, so a role can never fork fleet policy. Skill paths resolve relative to the role workspace.

accountant.label: Tax Accountant
accountant.blurb: Chiwah LTD maker + sweep: chiwah-tax workspace, tax-sweep procedure, default model

set.notes: Role: Tax Accountant (assigned via /role accountant). Chiwah LTD maker + sweep runner; workspace chiwah-tax (separate repo; never Health-tracker).

verifier.label: Tax Verifier
verifier.blurb: Chiwah LTD checker: chiwah-tax workspace, tax-verify procedure, independent model

set.notes: Role: Tax Verifier (assigned via /role verifier). Read-only checker; files findings, fixes nothing. Different provider from the maker by structural requirement.

general.label: General
general.blurb: Back to a thin clone of the master: no role workspace, skills, or model

set.notes: Role: general (assigned via /role general). Thin clone of the master; no per-role overrides.
